recipe.visualDefinition: A painterly, mid-century illustration of a woman in a vibrant pink dress leaning against furniture in a warm, red-toned interior. The style features visible brushstrokes, high-contrast lighting, and a rich, saturated color palette dominated by vermillion and ochre.
coreVisualRelationships: The woman's cool-toned skin and pink dress against the fiery red background
The verticality of the subject contrasted with the horizontal block of text
The detailed, stained-glass lamp providing a secondary focal point in the upper left
The rough, textured brushwork of the background vs. the smoother rendering of the figure
coreInvariants: Visible canvas or board texture through the paint

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length female figure positioned slightly left of center, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face and the bright pink of her dress serve as the primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the woman's face, moves down her body to the lower left plant, then sweeps right across the text block and up into the background texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of textured negative space on the right side to accommodate typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vermillion and Burnt Orange (Background and atmosphere)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with deep shadows in the furniture and background to create depth.
paletteRestrictions: Limited use of cool greens for balance

characterSpecificRedesigns: Overlapping characters in the display title to create a unified block

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the darker mid-tones of the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same geometric sans-serif family to distinguish title from tracklist.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tight geometric overlapping style of the era.
Provides the clean, geometric foundation for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: An oil painting of a woman in a short pink dress leaning against a dark wooden dresser in a room with red damask wallpaper. A stained-glass lamp glows in the upper left. Use thick, expressive brushstrokes and a warm, saturated color palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked geometric sans-serif text in the upper right quadrant using white and yellow. Add a smaller list of text in the lower right using a bolder weight of the same font family.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture painterly and not a flat digital gradient?
Does the text overlap slightly to create a compact block?
Is the color palette dominated by warm reds and oranges?
Is the woman's dress a distinct, vibrant pink?

adjustableVariables: Level of detail in the stained-glass lamp
Specific shade of the pink dress
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the woman
Exact pattern of the stained glass
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the textured background.
Check that the pink dress pops against the red environment.
Verify the brushwork looks hand-applied rather than filtered.
Confirm the geometric sans-serif font feels period-appropriate.
recipe.reuseFormula: Painterly 1960s illustration + Warm Red/Orange Palette + Geometric Sans-Serif Typography (Stacked/Overlapping) = Retro Southern Gothic Aesthetic
